Primary / Ages 3-15 stated; exact grades not fully specified

School web pages appear old; confirm current use of the contact channels. The listed +233 20 811 6584 number is explicitly for Accra and omitted from the Akim Oda school phones.
Named on school page; formal role not stated

Nursery / Primary / JSS/JHS; school's old page also says 'high school' without defining it
Only old 2011 school-authored posts were found. Level wording is ambiguous and phone must be reconfirmed; use as a low-priority candidate only.

Strong identity/data-integrity concerns: site gives an Eastern Region address but its directions text says East Legon/Accra and includes generic staff names/profile copy. Do not use these contacts until independently confirmed by Evans or NaSIA match.

Contact evidence is only available through a third-party mirror of school social posts; direct school-owned profile could not be opened, so all numbers need direct verification before future outreach.
